method: LibreOffice FODP Fontwork (reuse candidate); no application serializer change made

nativeWordArtCandidate.change: Removed p:cNvSpPr txBox="1" from the converted Fontwork shape

conclusion: ODF Fontwork reuses LibreOffice’s real Fontwork path and emits a preset text warp, but PowerPoint COM still reads the result as a text-box shape with TextEffect preset -2. Removing the textbox marker does not create native WordArt. This candidate cannot satisfy the requested native Shape.Type/TextEffect match and is not adopted.
